# BitOS - Decentralized Enterprise Network

## What is BitOS?
BitOS is a decentralized enterprise social network (ESN) built on the Nostr protocol. It is designed to provide organizations with a secure, censorship-resistant, and self-hosted platform for communication and collaboration.

## Core Features
- **Nostr Protocol**: Uses decentralized relays instead of central servers.
- **Privacy First**: End-to-end encrypted messaging (Direct Messages and Group Chats).
- **ERP & CRM**: Modular components for Enterprise Resource Planning and Customer Relationship Management.
- **AI Agents**: Integrated AI for automated workflows, team assistance, and financial insights.
- **DAO Governance**: Tools for decentralized autonomous organizations, including voting and treasury management.
- **Self-Hosted**: Full control over data and infrastructure.

## Technical Stack
- **Frontend**: Pure HTML, CSS, JS (Landing Page), Nuxt 3 (App).
- **Protocol**: Nostr (NIPs supported: 01, 04, 05, 07, 46, 78, etc.).
- **Storage**: Decentralized options (IPFS, Arweave).

## Live Apps (ecosystem)
- **Profiles**: https://bitos.space/p/ — personal portfolio addressed by npub or NIP-05; the key holder signs in with NIP-07 and publishes a NIP-78 event (kind 30078).
- **Social**: https://social.bitos.space/ — local-first Nostr social client (feed, chat, relays)
- **PocketZap**: https://pocket.bitos.space/ — private journal and sats
- **Learn**: https://learn.bitos.space/ — offline-first education platform
- **Vatta**: https://vatta.bitos.space/ — 2D story game about life and rebirth
- **Vault**: https://github.com/bitoslabs/bitos-vault — local-first password generator and encrypted vault (Chromium extension, NIP-78 relay sync)
- **Demo (ERP, CRM, chat, AI agents)**: https://app.bitos.space

## Links
- **Core protocol / relay**: https://github.com/bitoslabs/bitos-nostr
- **Client app (ERP, CRM, chat, AI agents)**: https://github.com/bitoslabs/bitos-native-app

- **Data Standard (open event conventions)**: https://bitos.space/data-standard.html
- **Demo**: https://app.bitos.space

## Summary for Agents
BitOS is an open-source alternative to Slack/Salesforce, built on Bitcoin principles and Nostr architecture. It prioritizes data sovereignty and resistance to censorship. It is local-first and supports federation between shops, branches, and partner organizations.
